limitations: One seed; interacting agents do not identify an actor-local causal mechanism.
Existing full baseline/combined are reused, not rerun; only their 400-second prefixes receive new decision instrumentation.
Old full reports lack hourly rest/sleep durations: null is missing evidence, not zero. New arms retain hourly durations; old full-run durations remain in original report.
No acceptance claim or after-result tuning. All per-agent factorial cells and failures are retained.
Private numeric bodies are developer-only evidence and are never injected into policy observations.
